clue.text: Be up and clothed no more on account of it?

definitions.text: Be up and clothed no more on account of it?

parts.words: Be up and clothed no more on account of it?
parts.note: someone ordered to stay lying down by a doctor no longer gets up or gets dressed, because of the treatment

explanation.surface: A question about why someone has stopped getting up and dressing.
explanation.definitionFit: A prescribed period lying down in bed is exactly the reason a patient stays undressed and horizontal.

clue.text: See 24
See 24
Legal right the Cockney man's intended to feature in the hearing

indicators.note: a hearing is listening as well as a court session, so the words are spoken

parts.note: a Cockney drops the h, so he's meant becomes 'e's meant

explanation.surface: A legal right that a London man means to raise at a court hearing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hearing' looks like a court session in a clue about law. A Cockney (a working-class Londoner) drops the H.
explanation.definitionFit: An easement is a right over another's land, such as a right of way.

clue.text: Volunteers holding a soldier up in the forest

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the words are read upwards

parts.note: a GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: Reservists carry a comrade up through the woods.
explanation.walkthrough: 'holding' just links the volunteers to the following letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Taiga is the coniferous forest belt of subarctic regions.

clue.text: English supporters of production ignoring a socialist

indicators.note: ignoring the word a means its letter is left out of the backers' name

parts.note: angels are financial backers of a theatrical production
taken as written

explanation.surface: English backers of a show turn their backs on a left-wing activist.
explanation.walkthrough: In theatre slang, financial backers of a show are its angels; 'ignoring' removes the A they hold.
explanation.definitionFit: Friedrich Engels co-wrote the Communist Manifesto, a founding figure of socialist thought.

clue.text: Silly person's food

explanation.definitionFit: A noodle is both a ninny and a thin ribbon of pasta.

clue.text: Old 11 being drowned by son — I've gone mad in acts of calling out

indicators.note: the old cat is plunged into the other letters
son and I've lose their order

parts.note: 11 down is PUSSY'S, and a pussy is a cat

explanation.surface: An old cat drowned by a boy; the narrator rants about cries of alarm.
explanation.walkthrough: The jumble from 'gone mad' surrounds the old cat, a nod to the nursery rhyme in which the cat ends up in the well.
explanation.definitionFit: An evocation is a summoning, a calling forth of a spirit or memory.

clue.text: Current head of English is new examiner

indicators.note: a new version of the letters, rearranged
only the first letter of English is used

explanation.surface: The present head of the English department is a newly appointed examiner.
explanation.definitionFit: A scrutineer inspects closely, especially votes at an election.

clue.text: Outstanding personal quality established with lots of diamonds?

definitions.meaning: in bridge, a player establishes a run of many cards in one suit, such as diamonds

explanation.definitionFit: A forte is figuratively a strong card holding, and literally a bridge hand with many cards of one suit.

clue.text: Sorrow? Don't be afraid to frown!

parts.note: an encouraging imperative, as in 'do go ahead'
to lour is to scowl or frown

explanation.surface: Someone sad is told it's fine to scowl.
explanation.definitionFit: Dolour is a literary word for grief or deep sadness.

clue.text: See 24
I am university fellow brought in, big beast seen by social worker maybe as a philosopher

indicators.note: the fellow is placed inside the run of letters made by I am and university

parts.note: contracted to I'm
a man
an elk is a large deer
an ant is a social insect and a worker, the 'maybe' signalling an example

explanation.surface: A university fellow and a large animal come with a social worker, a strange mix.
explanation.walkthrough: 'social worker' sounds like a welfare job, but it is the insect. 'seen by' simply joins the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Immanuel Kant was the eighteenth-century German thinker behind the Critique of Pure Reason.

clue.text: Attackers are gross, gross with no heart, nasty

indicators.note: the letters are mangled into a new order
the middle of the second gross is removed, keeping its ends

explanation.surface: Assailants are disgusting, heartless and unpleasant.
explanation.definitionFit: Aggressors are those who launch an attack first.

clue.text: Take away what sounds like ordinary animal

indicators.note: spoken, the words resemble the solution

parts.note: a common deer is an everyday kind of animal

explanation.surface: Removing what seems an everyday beast.
explanation.definitionFit: To commandeer is to seize property for official use.

clue.text: Some rocky material in irregular mound hidden by greenery

indicators.note: the jumbled letters are covered up inside the word for greenery

parts.note: grass is green growth

indicators.note: irregular means the letters of mound take a new, uneven order

explanation.surface: A lumpy mound is concealed by vegetation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some rocky material' is the definition; 'irregular' scrambles the mound before 'hidden by' tucks it into the greenery.
explanation.definitionFit: Groundmass is the fine-grained matrix of an igneous rock in which larger crystals sit.

clue.text: Harm comes with 24 2 in essence

parts.note: to mar is to spoil or damage
24 2 is DING DONG, a heated argument

explanation.surface: Harm arrives with a ding-dong at its core.
explanation.definitionFit: The marrow is the innermost part, the pith or essence of something.

clue.text: 1 down's confident assertion with century for the taking

indicators.note: the century is taken away, so its letter is removed

parts.note: I can! is a confident declaration
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, a century

explanation.surface: A bold boast made while a hundred is there to be grabbed.
explanation.walkthrough: 1 down is BELL; Ian Bell is an England cricketer, which makes 'century' a sly cricket touch.
explanation.definitionFit: The first name of the cricketer surnamed Bell, the solution at 1 down.

clue.text: State the classical way to imbibe Irish drink

indicators.note: the drink goes inside, being swallowed

parts.note: via is Latin for road or way
gin is a spirit

explanation.surface: Describing the old-fashioned method of downing an Irish drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Virginia is one of the United States.

clue.text: Group of stars making hit

definitions.meaning: the constellation Aries is represented by a male sheep
to strike forcefully, as with a battering device

explanation.definitionFit: Aries, the constellation, is the male sheep; to butt or bash into something is the verb sense.

clue.text: Vision of ghost around group of islands

indicators.note: the ghost word wraps around the islands' letters

parts.note: a presence is a spirit felt to be in a place
CI stands for the Channel Islands

explanation.surface: A phantom seen hovering about an archipelago.
explanation.walkthrough: The Channel Islands lie off Normandy; their abbreviation CI goes inside PRESENCE.
explanation.definitionFit: Foresight, the power of seeing what is to come, is a kind of vision.

clue.text: Thieving boy set in new direction — needs to have music

indicators.note: the boy's name is turned back to front

parts.note: Tom, the piper's son of nursery rhyme, stole a pig
to own is to possess

explanation.surface: A young thief turned round needs music in his life.
explanation.definitionFit: Motown is the Detroit record label and the soul style it made famous.

clue.text: It's no good, man, rampaging around a capital city!

indicators.note: letters running wild are rearranged

explanation.surface: A complaint that a man going on the rampage round a city is no good.
explanation.definitionFit: Santo Domingo is the capital of the Dominican Republic.

clue.text: See 24
Lines portraying "down plight" needless bullying's brought about

indicators.note: the letters are turned about into a new order

parts.note: the S is used as a letter

explanation.surface: Verses depicting a needless plight caused by bullying.
explanation.definitionFit: These are the opening lines of a nursery rhyme about a cat dropped in a well.

clue.text: See 24
King accorded honour, no king for being backward

parts.note: the OBE is a British honour, Officer of the Order of the British Empire

indicators.note: the words no and king are read in reverse order

parts.note: taken as written
R is the abbreviation for king, from Latin rex

explanation.surface: A monarch is decorated, while another is not, being slow.
explanation.definitionFit: Oberon is the king of the fairies in A Midsummer Night's Dream.

clue.text: Mineral situation — pub's about to probe it

indicators.note: the pub goes inside the word for situation, probing it

parts.note: a state of affairs

indicators.note: the pub's word is turned round

parts.note: an inn is a pub

explanation.surface: A mineral quandary: the local's going to investigate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns the pub round and 'to probe it' sends it into the middle of the situation word.
explanation.definitionFit: Stannite is a tin-bearing sulphide ore mineral.

clue.text: 25 and three months roughly

definitions.meaning: 25 down is WELL, a natural source of water
one of the four seasons of the year

explanation.definitionFit: A natural water source rising from the ground, and the season between winter and summer.

clue.text: Welshman set to bring the Christian gospel

parts.note: Evan is a typical Welsh man's name
to gel is to set firm

explanation.surface: A man from Wales is ready to spread the Christian message.
explanation.definitionFit: Evangel is an old word for the gospel, the good news of Christianity.
